name: Oddity
source:
You're not exactly prepared to raise a 10-year-old girl, but you're confident you'll manage. Your daughter, however, is a bit... odd. Sure, all parents have to teach their children that hurting people is wrong. And yes, sometimes you wake up in the middle of the night to find your daughter standing over you – but that's all part of being a parent.

Well... there's also the monsters, the shady organization after your daughter, and the psychic powers. But you can handle it... right?

[From [url=https://starlit-carnival-studios.itch.io/oddity]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你还没有完全准备好抚养一个10岁的女孩，但你有信心自己能做到。然而，你的女儿有点……奇怪。当然，所有父母都必须教导孩子，伤害别人是错误的。是的，有时你会在半夜醒来，发现你的女儿站在你身边——但这就是作为父母的一部分。

嗯……还有怪物、追随你女儿的阴暗组织，以及心灵力量。但你可以处理它……对吗？

[来自[url=https://starlit-carnival-studios.itch.io/oddity]Itch.io[/url]]
